sentences.text: No, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges on a cash credit/overdraft facility if the borrower intimates the bank of the intention not to renew the facility before the period stipulated in the loan agreement and the facility is closed on the due date.
The bank’s own policy defines “pre-payment” or “pre-closure” as repayment of a loan, in full or in part, before its scheduled due date.
